chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from al-Husayn b. al-Hasan al-Qurashi from Sulayman b. Jafar al-Basri from Abdullah b. al-Husayn b. Zayd b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Ali b. Abi Talib from his father from al-Sadiq Jafar b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Surely, Allah, blessed and exalted, has disliked for you, O Nation, twenty-four characteristics and has prohibited them from you: He disliked fiddling in prayer; He disliked reminding others of goodwill in charity; He disliked laughing among graves; He disliked peeping in houses; He disliked gazing at the private parts of women - and he said: it causes blindness; He disliked speaking during intercourse - and he said: it causes muteness; He disliked sleeping before the final Isha; He disliked socializing after the final Isha; He disliked bathing beneath the sky without a cover; He disliked intercourse beneath the sky; He disliked entering rivers except with a cover - and he said: in the rivers are inhabitants and dwellers from the angels; He disliked entering bathhouses except with a cover; He disliked speaking between the adhan and iqama in the dawn prayer until the prayer is completed; He disliked sailing the sea in its frenzy; He disliked sleeping upon a roof that is not plastered - and he said: whoever sleeps on a roof not plastered, responsibility is absolved from him; He disliked that a man sleeps in a house alone; He disliked for a man to approach his wife while she is menstruating, for if he does so and the child comes out leprous or albinotic, then let him blame none but himself; He disliked that a man approaches a woman while having had a wet dream until he bathes from the dream that he saw, for if he does and the child comes out insane, then let him blame none but himself; He disliked that a man speaks to a leper except that there is between them the measure of an armlength - and he said: flee from the leper as you flee from the lion; He disliked urinating on the bank of a flowing river; He disliked that a man relieves himself under a tree that has blossomed or a date palm that has ripened - meaning borne fruit; He disliked that a man puts on sandals while standing; He disliked that a man enters a dark house except with a lamp or fire before him; and He disliked blowing in prayer.
ai.seo_question: What are the twenty-four characteristics that Allah disliked according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (S) enumerates twenty-four characteristics that Allah has disliked and prohibited for the Muslim community. These range from conduct during worship (fiddling in prayer, blowing in prayer) to social etiquette (peeping in houses, laughing at graves, reminding of charity), intimate relations (approaching one's spouse during menstruation or without purification), hygiene and modesty (bathing without cover, entering bathhouses naked), safety (sleeping on unprotected roofs, sailing in storms), and health (proximity to lepers). The hadith also includes interspersed explanations from the Prophet about the consequences of some of these acts.
